entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about an order. I... I just don't know what to do. I was so excited for it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could you tell me a bit more about the order? What specifically is the issue?
It's the Pro-Line cycling jersey I bought. I finally got a chance to try it on for a big ride, and it's the wrong size. It's just... so much smaller than I expected.
Okay, I see. So to clarify, is it a technical fault with the jersey, or a preference issue regarding the fit?

It's the fit. It's just way too tight. I feel terrible about it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for this specific jersey. I really needed that money back if it wasn't going to work out.

I completely understand your disappointment, and I want to thank you for your loyalty. Let me just pull up your account... Okay, I see the purchase here. It looks like it was delivered about 71 days ago.
I know, it's been a while. I was just so busy... I was hoping it wasn't too late.
Not at all. I've just checked our policy, and for that jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you.
Of course. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size? We can certainly help you find the right fit.
An exchange would be wonderful, actually. I still really want the jersey.

Excellent. And because you're one of our VIP customers, I'm going to process that exchange with complimentary expedited shipping for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label now. Just send the original jersey back, and we'll have the new size on its way.
Wow, thank you so much, Alex. You've really turned my day around. I appreciate it.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Have a great day and enjoy your new jersey when it arrives.
